250-779-1479-1669-8293.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-8293.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-1669-8293.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

When the Phyrexian Germ enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Phyrexian Germ.
Repeat from step 2.

You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Undercover Operative and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1021-5231-5414-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-5231-5414-6761.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-5231-5414-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

2921-4484-4871-5643-6747.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2921-4484-4871-5643-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
2921-4484-4871-5643-6747.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2921-4484-4871-5643-6747.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
